name: Overhead Barbell Press
imageCaption: Overhead barbell press, starting position (Free Exercise DB)
imageEndCaption: Step 3: the bar is pushed above the head (Free Exercise DB)
steps: Stand with your feet about shoulder width apart and hold the bar at shoulder height.
Tighten your stomach and keep your back straight.
Push the bar straight up until your arms are straight above your head.
Lower the bar slowly back to your shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
imageCaption: Dumbbell shoulder press, starting position (Free Exercise DB)
imageEndCaption: Step 3: the dumbbells are pushed above the head (Free Exercise DB)
steps: Sit on a bench with back support and hold one dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Keep your feet flat on the floor and your wrists straight.
Push the dumbbells up until your arms are straight.
Lower the dumbbells slowly back to shoulder height.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
imageCaption: Dumbbell lateral raise, starting position (Free Exercise DB)
imageEndCaption: Step 3: the arms are raised to shoulder height (Free Exercise DB)
steps: Stand upright with a dumbbell in each hand, keeping your arms down at your sides and your elbows slightly bent.

name: Cable Face Pull
imageCaption: Cable face pull, starting position (Free Exercise DB)
imageEndCaption: Step 3: the rope is pulled to the face (Free Exercise DB)
steps: Set the cable at face height, attach a rope and hold it with both hands.
Step back until your arms are straight and keep your body steady.
Pull the rope towards your face and move your elbows out to the sides.
Squeeze your upper back, then return slowly to the start position.

name: Arnold Press
imageCaption: Arnold press, starting position (Free Exercise DB)
imageEndCaption: Step 3: the arms are straight above the head with the palms forward (Free Exercise DB)
steps: Sit with one dumbbell in each hand in front of your chest and your palms facing you.
Push the dumbbells up and turn your palms to face forward while you press.
Stop when your arms are straight above your head.
Lower the dumbbells slowly and turn your palms back towards you.
